messages:
asha: quick convo: we need a playbook for edge transcode -> how gateway emits canonical routing and how the console surfaces both canonical and observed transport views. low churn, minimal user-visible regressions.

mike: proto-first internally, gateway transcode to support existing HTTP clients. main ops concerns: preserving attribution for quotas and billing, and making transcode behavior debuggable.

sam: concrete ask from billing: every request needs a stable canonical key so cost for a ModelService.Generate call always maps to the same cost bucket regardless of transport. header idea: `x-canonical-key: inference.v1.ModelService.Generate:v1`.

tess: console needs two things: (1) a toggle to switch between "canonical" and "observed" metrics for a route, and (2) an incident lens that shows when transcode fallbacks happened for tenant X. small mock would help.

mike: gateway contract proposal (short):
```
- Always attach: x-canonical-key, x-proto-sha, x-transport-observed
- Stamp pre-quota-check: x-quota-check-id, x-quota-window
- On any conversion loss: set x-transcode-status=partial and include x-transcode-drop-count
- If gateway falls back to passthrough: x-transcode-fallback=true
```

devex: rollout: opt-in tenants only for first spike. feature flag with percent rollout and per-tenant opt-in. stop conditions: transcode-fallback rate >0.1% OR visible billing mismatch >0.5% vs baseline.

ingest-bot: ingestion pipeline note: we'll add a joiner that maps gateway logs (with x-canonical-key) to traces. This means historical HTTP-only traces need a backfill or will be labeled as 'legacy:observed_http'.

sam: quota enforcement detail: gateway pre-checks give a `x-quota-token` which downstream can reference. On 429 send body { "error": "quota_exceeded", "quota": "tokens", "remaining": 0, "help": "https://redwood.internal/docs/quota" }. Keep shape stable for SDKs.

mike: streaming nuance: we cannot emulate bidi gRPC over plain HTTP reliably. document that long-lived streams from server => client use SSE, and client->server streaming is unsupported in HTTP fallback. return 501 if client asks for bidi and not supported.

tess: UI idea: route detail page shows a two-column view: left = canonical metrics (p50/p95/cost), right = observed transport (avg body size, transport-latency). show a small badge when any transcode-status != ok in last 24h.

asha: compliance: proto schema changes must include backward compatibility check in CI and a transcode test vector that validates gateway behavior. add a git hook that ensures field numbers are stable.

mike: sidecar spike plan (1.5w): minimal transcode logic, header stamping, emit transcode events to stdout. target p50 transcode overhead <5ms.

devex: I'll write the canary playbook and feature flag spec. Include rollback automation if 5xx increases or transcode errors spike.

taskbot: Created task INF-1622: edge transcode playbook + console mapping -> assignees: mike, tess, sam, devex

asha: ok locking. sync Monday 9:30 to kick off. keep messages short in the spike channel. thanks.

mike: on it :muscle:

tess: will mock the UI this week :art:

sam: will draft header spec and quota flow :memo:
